title: Capture the worker heartbeat CI failure evidence
goal: Record the actual failing attempt, unchanged runtime, isolated diagnostic and retry without claiming a fix
acceptance: Failure and retry remain distinct dated evidence
No worker/runtime behavior or assertion is changed
Reserve the new bug ID before publishing the record
privacy: Neutral repository fixtures only; no model inference, private hosts or device operations
validation: Check actual CI attempts and source diff
Validate the record and generated views
escalation: Do not infer a root cause or claim a fix from a passing retry
